label: Executives reporting AI agents in production
question: Are AI agents actually running in production?
answer: 52% of executives report their organisations have deployed AI agents in production, per a Google Cloud study from September 2025.
sample: 3,466 senior leaders across 24 countries at enterprises above USD 10m revenue that already deploy generative AI, fielded April–June 2025. The figure is a share of gen-AI-adopting enterprises, not of all enterprises
methodology: Google Cloud's ROI of AI study, September 2025: 3,466 senior leaders across 24 countries at enterprises above USD 10m revenue, fielded April–June 2025. Cross-industry sample rather than travel-specific, which is the main caveat on reading it next to travel's own figures.
